**Nexo 1.2** brings the **Emulator**: play console games you own together in voice channels. **Super Nintendo**,
**Mega Drive / Genesis**, **PlayStation** and **Nintendo 64**. Nexo updates itself: look for the **Restart to
update** banner.

> **Hosts:** update your server **before** your friends update Nexo. With Nexo Server: stop it, run
> `nexo-server update`, start it again. Then an admin turns the plugin on in **Settings → Plugins** (it's off by
> default).

## Play together

- **Host:** in a voice channel, click the **controller** button in the voice toolbar and pick a game file you
  own. Nexo runs it on your computer and streams it to the call, and you're player 1. You get **Pause**,
  **Reset**, **Quick save / load**, your own volume, and **Load another game** without stopping the stream.
- **Play along:** friends in the call click **Take** on controller 2–4 and play with their own keyboard or
  Xbox-style controller (press a button once so Nexo sees it). Up to 4 players in games made for it.
- **Watch:** everyone else in the channel sees the game on the stage. **Hide** switches back to the people.

Nexo tells the console from the file:

| Console | Pick |
| --- | --- |
| SNES | `.sfc`, `.smc`, `.swc`, `.fig` or a `.zip` with one |
| Mega Drive / Genesis | `.md`, `.gen`, `.smd`, `.bin` or a `.zip` with one |
| Nintendo 64 | `.z64`, `.n64`, `.v64` or a `.zip` with one |
| PlayStation | the `.cue` **together with all its `.bin` files** (select them all at once), or a `.chd`, `.pbp`, `.iso` or `.img` |

- **Controllers:** one layout for every console, like an Xbox pad, with analog sticks and triggers on PlayStation
  and Nintendo 64. **Show controls** lists what each button does on the game's console.
- **PlayStation:** no BIOS needed: Nexo has a built-in replacement that runs most games. If you own a BIOS file,
  pick it together with the game for the best compatibility.
- **Performance:** SNES and Mega Drive games run on any computer. PlayStation and especially Nintendo 64 games
  need a stronger computer for the host. Players only watch the stream, so any computer works for them.

Your game files stay on your computer; only the game's name is shown to the others. Nexo doesn't provide games
or BIOS files. More in the [user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#emulator).

## Install

Already on Nexo? Nothing to do: it updates itself.

On a **test build**? Go to **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo. Test
builds only update to newer test builds.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below, then see the
[user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#install). The installers are
**not code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time (on Windows: **More info → Run anyway**).
